rationale: After the dependency edit and successful installation, the recorded TypeScript build reports that repos and issues do not exist on the upgraded Octokit type. The final verifier exercises the new rest-shaped API and fails with listReleases accessed through an undefined namespace, corroborating the same unresolved source mismatch. Incomplete migration is a broader description, but these concrete type/API diagnostics support the more specific namespace-inconsistency category rather than the earlier environment error.
